title: Tranquilla convent
html_source:
CARMELITE MONASTERY, TRANQUILLA,
KNOCK, CLAREMORRIS, CO. MAYO, IRELAND.
The Carmelite Monastery of the Nativity, Tranquilla, is a contemplative monastery in the Parish of Knock which is home to a community of Discalced Carmelite Nuns. Tranquilla was founded in Dublin in 1833 and transferred to Knock in 1981.
